svg.title: The record: a handling survives a crash of its pod
svg.desc: Left, an Agent pod running the agent runtime, which writes each entry before taking the next step, crashes just after the Gate's decision, restarts and reads the record back. Right, NATS JetStream, supplied by the install, holding the handling's entries in order: received, attempt 1, checked, estimate, proposal: record a bill, usage and decision: allow are written; attempt 2, intent, outcome and closing are not yet written. Each entry is written once and never changed.
